title: Cute, but much smaller than pictures indicate
text: Cute, but much smaller than pictures indicate. Looks way smaller in real life than the pictures indicate. To be fair, it is as described, but I’m not good at visualizing measurements. So I tend to go by the pictures. The pictures make it look wider and more of a presence than it is.
